summary.en: A chapter card: a 640 px numeral on one side, a mono label, the chapter title at 225 px over a 12 px ink rule and a caption; the numeral steps 6 px on every beat while it holds.
summary.zh: 章节卡：一侧是 640 px 的巨型数字，另一侧是等宽标签、225 px 的章节标题、12 px 墨线和一行说明；停留时数字每拍挪 6 px。

fits: Between parts of a claim-plus-steps film: one card per chapter, two seconds each.
notFor: Films with one part; titles longer than two words; a film already paced by another chapter device.

intent.en: The film announces its structure like a poster series: a giant numeral says where you are before the page says what.
intent.zh: 片子像一套海报那样报出结构：先用巨型数字说“第几部分”，再由页面说“是什么”。

content.en: Number (1–2 digits), label (≤ 14 chars), title (≤ 14 chars), caption (≤ 40 chars); side left or right.
content.zh: 编号（1–2 位）、标签（≤ 6 字）、标题（≤ 5 字）、说明（≤ 16 字）；数字在左或在右。

fits.zh: “主张 + 步骤”型片子各部分之间：每章一张卡，各约两秒。

notFor.zh: 只有一部分的片子；超过两个词的标题；已经用别的章节手法定节奏的片子。

en: Two chapter cards in a row lose the numeral's weight; put a page between them.
zh: 两张章节卡挨着放，巨型数字就失去分量；中间要隔一页。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
